instruction: Riga 166: sostituire "For spatial benchmarks, the first repeat served as a JIT/warmup run and was excluded; we report the mean of repeats 2-5." con "For the spatial benchmarks each repeat ran in a new process with empty Numba and CuPy JIT caches, so every repeat includes JIT compilation and, for ligand-receptor analysis, the download of the OmniPath database. Co-occurrence, neighbourhood enrichment and ligand-receptor analysis used the same cell groups in all runs, the Leiden labels of the first CPU reference repeat. Squidpy 1.8.1 sets the Numba thread count to one during neighbourhood enrichment and keeps it for the rest of the process, so ligand-receptor analysis, which follows it, ran with one Numba thread in both pipelines." Facoltativo, a scelta del PI: aggiungere "In earlier runs in which the five repeats shared one process, this setting slowed the CPU co-occurrence after the first repeat by a factor of about 49; the results reported here do not have this defect." I valori 6.4x e 29.3x ricalcolati dalla revisione non si usano: i numeri spatial vengono da S1 (R0280).
